title: Czealo's PvP Pack
description:
轻量16x原版风PvP包。仅必要修改，流畅顺手。
(Lightweight 16x vanilla PvP pack. Essential tweaks only. Smooth, clean, responsive. )
body:
# **描述**
**一款简洁的16x原版风格PvP资源包，忠实于Minecraft原有的视觉美学。轻量化设计，经过优化，仅包含最必要的修改，旨在提供流畅、灵敏的PvP体验，避免多余内容造成干扰。欢迎试用——期待你的反馈！**

# **Description**
**A compact 16x vanilla-style PvP resource pack that stays true to the original Minecraft aesthetic. Lightweight and optimized, it includes only the most essential modifications to deliver a smooth, responsive PvP experience without unnecessary clutter. Give it a try—feedback is always welcome!**
